archetypes.name: exit-code-mapper
archetypes.rationale: The plan introduces new action exit codes whose caller-site routing is easy to mismatch or accidentally preempt with legacy guards.
archetypes.prompt_body: Trace the proposed rc10/rc11/rc12/rc13 contract from design-postplan-emit.sh through each named caller and retained fallback path. Look for plan holes where old rc0/rc1-only checks, stdout-KV parsing, or missing same-site re-entry could make a documented action unreachable or semantically different. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: sentinel-lifecycle
archetypes.rationale: The merge changes which path owns .completed markers, creating high risk of lifecycle drift across clean, override, split, and refine returns.
archetypes.prompt_body: Audit whether the plan consistently preserves the legacy completion-marker lifecycle for .completed/step-2b and .completed/step-2b.5 across initial, Gate B, discussion, Step 1e, Override, and Split Refine-return paths. Compare the proposed sentinel responsibilities against the existing workflow prose and scripts to find missing writes, duplicate ownership, or inconsistent continuation targets. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: kv-display-boundary
archetypes.rationale: The plan depends on a subtle split between display output, result-env state, stderr sidecars, and helper diagnostics.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the proposed output-boundary contract for merged mode: display-only FD3/stdout, result-env KVs, nonfatal warning logs, stderr sidecars, and suppression of append-helper KVs. Check whether every caller and test target in scope has enough plan detail to avoid KV leakage, unsafe sourcing, or lost diagnostics when plan-size or validation subcommands fail. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: doc-topology-sync
archetypes.rationale: This change spans SKILL.md, reference docs, script docs, and structure tests, so cross-document contract drift is a primary plan risk.
archetypes.prompt_body: Compare the planned edits across the listed skill prompt, reference docs, script docs, and structural tests for inconsistent caller lists, flag semantics, prompt options, or retained-vs-merged behavior. Focus on whether downstream documentation would teach operators and implementers the same contract that the scripts and tests are expected to enforce. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
